[[Hargrave Military Academy|Hargrave]] ([[Chatham, Virginia]]) | college = [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] (2013–2015) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Second-team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2015) * [[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] All-Rookie Team (2014) * Derby Classic MVP (2012) }} '''Terry William Rozier''' (born March 17, 1994) is an American [[college basketball]] player who currently plays for the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]] {{cite web|title=Terry Rozier Bio|url=http://www.gocards.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/terry_rozier_862096.html|website=''GoCards.com''|accessdate=29 March 2015}} and who has made himself eligible for the [[2015 NBA Draft]]. He made the [[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] All-Rookie Team in 2014. He was also the Derby Classic MVP in 2012. ==High school career== Rozier starred at [[Shaker Heights High School]] in [[Shaker Heights, Ohio]], graduating in 2012. In his senior year, he averaged 25.6 points, 6.5 rebounds, 4.5 assists and 4.7 steals, leading Shaker to a 21-3 record and taking them to the regional semifinal in 2012 for the first time since 2002. He was an All-Lake Erie League player for three years and was rated 74th overall in the 2012 [[ESPNU]] Top 100 players.{{cite web | url = http://shakerite.com/raiderzone/2015/04/05/former-shaker-guard-declares-for-the-nba-draft/ | title = Former Shaker Guard Declares for the NBA Draft | work= The Shakerite | date = 6 April 2015}} Due to grades, Rozier played for [[Hargrave Military Academy]] for a year before becoming a Cardinal. At Hargrave, Rozier averaged 29.3 points, 7.8 rebounds and 5.6 assist. Hargrave went 38-8 during the 2012-13 season.{{cite web | url = http://shakerite.com/raiderzone/2012/09/19/roziers-cardinal-career-on-hold-for-now/ | title = Rozier's Cardinal Career on Hold for Now | work= The Shakerite | date = 19 September 2012}} ==College career== As a sophomore, Rozier led the Cardinals in scoring with 17.1 points per game. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Persondata | NAME = Rozier, Terry | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = | DATE OF BIRTH = 1994-03-17 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Youngstown, Ohio]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Rozier, Terry}} [[Category:1994 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Ohio]] [[Category:Guards (basketball)]] [[Category:Louisville Cardinals men's basketball players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Youngstown, Ohio]] [[Category:People from Shaker Heights, Ohio]] {{ULouisville-stub}}
